NAME: THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Listen up <color=#FF0000>peasant</color>: I'm legally obligated to tell you this.

NAME: THE MAN
TUTORIAL: This little rock is <color=#FF0000>Terra 5</color> -- owned by the Agricultural Space Society -- and it's host to a whole ecosystem of plants and life.

NAME: THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Each day here lasts 60 seconds, so hurry up and <color=#FF0000>get a move on</color>.

NAME: THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Yeah, just like that. Now <color=#FF0000>grab your scythe</color>, -- you're about to get your hands dirty.

NAME: Press 3 or scroll to hold the scythe.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: There's a native plant just over there. <color=#FF0000>Harvest him</color>. It's ok -- he doesn't have any direct relatives left alive anyway.

NAME: Right click while holding the scythe to harvest the plant.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Notice how <color=#FF0000>the seed is left</color> after you harvested him.

NAME: THE MAN
TUTORIAL: First, get used to your bag. Open it, close it, then head to the house store.

NAME: Open your inventory with E, then press E again to close it.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: You can both buy and sell here. Hurry up and <color=#FF0000>pawn that plant</color>.

NAME: Walk to the house and press I to open the store. Then open the Sell tab and sell your harvested plant.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: <color=#FF0000>Buying more plants</color> will be essential to your survival.

NAME: Buy a Glowbud seed from the store's Buy tab.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: The seed was transferred to your inventory. <color=#FF0000>Move it to your pocket</color>.

NAME: Drag the Glowbud seed from your inventory to your hotbar.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: To <color=#FF0000>plant a seed</color>, you first need to <color=#FF0000>prepare the ground</color>.

NAME: Till the ground using your hoe so you can plant the seed. You may need to clear the grass using your scythe.
Go to the tilled ground and plant your Glowbud seed by clicking on it.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Your <color=#FF0000>plants need water</color> to grow. Make sure you're watering them <color=#FF0000>when they request it</color>.

NAME: Water the plant by right clicking on it with your watering can.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: You thought all of this advice was for free?

NAME: Open the debt manager in your inventory and pay off your first payment.
THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Good. <color=#FF0000>Now make the rest of your payments on time</color>.

NAME: THE MAN
TUTORIAL: Or don't. If you miss a payment, I make more money with interest.

NAME: SAM
TUTORIAL: Is there anything else I need to know?
